scope: Capacity observations are from one synthetic amd64 CI run over an isolated internal Docker bridge, with real TLS certificate/hostname verification and unchanged service rate limits. No forwarded-IP spoofing or public port.
Latency values are observations; no new acceptance threshold or production performance promise is inferred. Logical latency includes bounded Retry-After waits.
Docker memory samples include page cache and are not exact peak RSS. Client work is outside the server CPU/memory cgroup.
Capacity restore is an isolated same-epoch consistent snapshot reopen, not production cross-machine RPO/RTO acceptance.
ARM64 job is a native aarch64 container lifecycle, persistence, credential revocation and consistent restore smoke test; it is not an ARM64 capacity benchmark.
Reports contain synthetic statistics and CI identifiers only. No real user data, tokens, credentials or private keys are included.
